title: Precalculus: Concepts Through Functions, A Unit Circle Approach to Trigonometry

sources.what: retailer listing for ISBN 9780321644879 that prints the full table of contents
retailer listing confirming title, 2nd edition, both authors, Pearson 2010

summary: A function-centered precalculus text that introduces a new family of functions in each chapter and teaches trigonometry from the unit circle before right triangles. It runs from a foundations chapter on graphs and lines through linear, quadratic, polynomial, rational, exponential, logarithmic, and trigonometric functions to polar coordinates, vectors, conics, systems and matrices, sequences, probability, and a closing preview of limits, derivatives, and integrals. Two appendices review algebra essentials and graphing-calculator use.

notes: ISBN 9780321644879 is not Sullivan's standard 'Precalculus' (9th edition, 2012, ISBN 9780321716835); it is the 2nd edition of the 'Concepts Through Functions, A Unit Circle Approach to Trigonometry' book, co-authored by Michael Sullivan III. Its order differs from the classic Sullivan text: functions come first, and trigonometry is defined on the unit circle before right-triangle applications (Chapter 7). Every chapter after Chapter F ends with a Chapter Review, Chapter Test, and Chapter Projects, and Chapters 2-13 add a Cumulative Review. Section descriptions are mostly from general knowledge of the topics; the source lists titles only.
